claims.claim: Process A runs a tool turn and exits; process B verifies and resumes the same session with byte-consistent history, preserved old signatures and appended new evidence
claims.evidence: tests/sessionResume.test.ts:93 ('B verifies and resumes A's session: byte-consistent history, old signatures kept, new evidence appended'), tests/sessionOwnership.test.ts:64 (explicit release preserves the signed prefix), tests/jsonlWriterResume.test.ts:83 (real killed writer: original prefix survives genuine resume); all passed in this session's run at 6e7875f2

claims.claim: Tampered history fails before model/tool dispatch
claims.evidence: src/session/sessionResume.ts:115-134 (assertChainIntact / assertLedgerVerifies throw TAMPERED) run inside step 1 through a read-only handle (sessionResume.ts:188-196) before any writer lock or append; tests/sessionResume.test.ts:119 passes. Mutation M1b: prefixing all four TAMPERED throws (lines 122,133,163,205) with `if (false)` made 'tampered history is refused before anything is appended' and 'forking a tampered parent is refused' fail (2 failed | 9 passed); source restored, git diff empty
claims.note: An earlier mutation attempt (M1) was inconclusive because `false && A || B || C` left the seq/prev-hash checks live; M1b is the valid mutation.

claims.evidence: src/session/sessionResume.ts:222-231 (open turn -> recoverSession, 'Nothing is re-executed'); src/session/sessionRecovery.ts:584 (outcome TOOL_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN); tests/sessionResume.test.ts:177, tests/sessionOwnership.test.ts:45 and :76, tests/sessionRecoveryRetry.test.ts (2 test.each cases asserting tool/result count stays 1 with TOOL_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN), tests/nativeRecoveryControl.test.ts:84 — all passed at 6e7875f2

claims.claim: Legal-boundary fork records verified parent lineage without writing the parent

claims.claim: Tests cover writer contention, repeated resume and future unsupported formats
claims.evidence: tests/sessionResume.test.ts:155 (live writer wins), :164 (A->B->C repeated resume), :141 (future envelope version refused, not migrated); tests/sessionOwnership.test.ts:35 (two live processes), tests/jsonlWriterResume.test.ts:110 and :142 (mutex contention); src/session/sessionResume.ts:95-113 envelopedRows raises UNSUPPORTED_FORMAT. claims.note: Acceptance item not met at 6e7875f2: no defined migration/evolution receipt format, only fail-closed refusal of v!=1.

result.proposedLinearComment:
Phase A step 1 reconciliation at integration commit 6e7875f21bb6b30bc0f1a32713deb3bc6a7cad2f (amc/gap-register-execution). Environment: Darwin 25.6.0 arm64, Node v25.5.0, pnpm 10.33.0, isolated fresh worktree, pnpm install --frozen-lockfile and pnpm build exit 0. Verdict: PARTIAL.

Verified at this commit: every implementation commit named on this issue (62c8b44a, 4cd258f5, 927a92ae, 73b7ae43, e8448405, fdabeba9, 96accade, b516869e, efb4b638, 8d09ddd4) is an ancestor of HEAD. Regression run: `npx vitest run tests/sessionResume.test.ts tests/sessionOwnership.test.ts tests/sessionRecoveryRetry.test.ts tests/jsonlWriterResume.test.ts tests/nativeRecoveryControl.test.ts tests/sessionRecovery.test.ts` — 6 files, 64 passed / 0 failed / 0 skipped (14.88 s). Cross-process resume with byte-consistent prefix, tamper refusal before any writer opens (sessionResume.ts:115-134, 188-196), non-replayed crash recovery (sessionRecovery.ts:584 TOOL_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN), verified fork lineage (sessionResume.ts:288-303), writer contention / repeated resume / future-envelope refusal, and ACP loadSession/forkSession advertised only when a factory is bound (acpAgentServer.ts:218-219) all hold in source and tests.

Mutation checks (each restored, git diff empty): disabling all four TAMPERED throws in sessionResume.ts turned 2 of 11 resume tests red; replacing the LIVE_WRITER throw at sessionOwnership.ts:56 with a silent return turned 2 of 21 ownership/resume tests red.

Not verifiable here: the receipts behind the quoted counts (11,107/0/0 at fdabeba9, 23/23 and 20/20 at b516869e, 20/2 at efb4b638, installed tgz) live under gitignored tmp/ or untracked AMC_OS/RESEARCH/2026-09-08-dsh-pi/ and 2026-09-09-phase-a-reconciliation/, none present at this commit. Fourteen commits touched the resume/recovery/ACP/SDK/Studio sources after the last qualified pin 8d09ddd4, so those historical numbers do not describe HEAD; the counts above are the current evidence for the scoped files.

Not exercised: full suite, installed package, Chromium/Studio, real provider, human, non-macOS platforms, the recovery-control-gap batch's own mutations and installed scenarios.

Still open before Done: (1) the acceptance item "immutable format evolution/migration receipts" has no definition — only the UNSUPPORTED_FORMAT refusal exists; (2) durable in-repo receipts for the quoted counts; (3) a single-commit full-suite run at the integration commit; (4) closure of the recovery-control-gap batch (disposition.json: batchFullyAccepted=false, candidate02 never promoted); (5) installed crash-after-side-effect non-replay acceptance; (6) dated Obsidian note and release-gate disposition.
